author: BenjaminRS
body:
This PR updates the TQ BDT to [L1TQBDT_OldKF_v1.0.0](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-tracker-phase2-data-processing/BE_firmware/track-finder/l1-track-finding-track-quality/-/tags/L1TQBDT_OldKF_v1.0.0). It was created using the [TQ CI pipeline #16528023](https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-tracker-phase2-data-processing/BE_firmware/track-finder/l1-track-finding-track-quality/-/pipelines/16528023) from the master branch.
Slides are attached detailing the modifications made this year and the validation performed on L1T objects.
[TQUpdate_261127.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/35530959/TQUpdate_261127.pdf)
title: Updating the TQBDT to v1.0.0 (May2026 training)
